description: This file defines the ClientRepository interface, which extends JpaRepository for managing Client entities and includes custom query methods for retrieving clients based on various attributes such as name, address, user, status, creation date, and NIP.

classes.name: ClientRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Client entities, extending JpaRepository and providing custom query methods.

methods.name: findByNameIgnoreCase
methods.description: Finds a client by name ignoring case sensitivity.

methods.name: findByNameContainingIgnoreCaseOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients whose names contain a given substring ignoring case, ordered by name ascending.

methods.name: findByNameContainingIgnoreCaseAndAddressCityOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients by name substring and address city, both ignoring case, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByUser
methods.description: Finds clients associated with a specific user.

methods.name: findByUserOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients associated with a specific user, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByUserIn
methods.description: Finds clients associated with any of the users in the provided list.

methods.name: findByCreatedAfter
methods.description: Finds clients created after a specific date.

methods.name: findByCreatedBetween
methods.description: Finds clients created between two dates.

methods.name: findByStatusAndAddressCityOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients by status and address city, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByStatusOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients by status, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByAddressCityOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients by address city, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByAddressCityContainingIgnoreCaseOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients with address city containing a substring, ignoring case, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByAddressRegionOrderByNameAsc
methods.description: Finds clients by address region, ordered by name.

methods.name: findByNipContaining
methods.description: Finds clients with NIP containing a specific substring.
